text:
maria: Heads-up — I opened a PR to update the audit/export and retention examples in the docs. Need legal sign-off on wording plus SDK snippets for python/ruby/go.

alex: Link?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — includes: change 'TTL' language in public docs, add JSONL export example, and replace insecure sample keys used in old snippets.

sam: :eyes: I'll take the python snippet. Reminder we want to use the new `client.audit.export(...)` pattern.

kevin: I can handle the Go snippet. Quick q — do we show retention as days or ISO interval?

emily: Legal note: prefer 'retention period' instead of 'TTL' in customer-facing docs. Also avoid wording that implies deletes remove data from backups; say backups may be retained per our backup policy.

maria: Thanks @emily — I'll swap TTL -> 'retention period' and add a short backup note. Sam/kevin, can you push SDK changes into the same PR so we keep everything bundled?

sam: Pushed a commit to the PR with the python example. snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
for record in client.audit.export(scope='account', retention_days=90):
    print(record)
```

kevin: Added Go example as a commit: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient()
it := client.AuditExport("account", 90)
for it.Next() {
    fmt.Println(it.Value())
}
```

alex: CI linkchecker flagged two broken links: `/sdk/go` -> should be `/sdk/go/quickstart`, and `/privacy/export` -> 404.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Broken links found in PR #842: `/sdk/go`, `/privacy/export`. CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/links/842

maria: I'll fix the links in the PR. @emily any remaining wording concerns?

emily: One small edit: change the phrase 'destroy from system' to simply 'delete from active storage' to avoid implying backup deletion. Otherwise LGTM.

sam: LGTM from eng side, tests pass locally. After links and wording tweak this should be merge-ready.

maria: Merged the PR :tada: — thanks all. I'll follow up to coordinate changelog entry and customer-facing note about retention semantics.
